entities.summary: Herbert List was a German photographer, who worked for magazines, including Vogue, Harper's Bazaar, and Life, and was associated with Magnum Photos. His austere, classically posed black-and-white compositions, particularly his homoerotic male nudes, taken in Italy and Greece being influential in modern photography and contemporary fashion photography. Herbert List was a painters & sculptors from Hamburg (1903-10-07, Hamburg–1975-04-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
